title: Hot Topics in Nutrition: Organic Food
summary: A cancer-centre dietitian explains USDA organic labelling, finds the evidence on organic food and cancer inconclusive, and puts produce intake first.

regardless of whether you choose organic or conventional fruits or vegetables, produce intake is extremely important
a child could consume 181 servings of strawberries in one day and have no detrimental effects

just because something is organic does not necessarily mean that it's healthier
